A_scene.heading: SCENE 02 - INT. CASH VAN - COLOMBO - NIGHT - 1.5 MINUTES
A_scene.title: The Route Change
A_scene.summary: Dinu drives through Colombo while Aruni's recorded message expresses concern about Nimal and his promised visit. Mudalali orders a different destination, and Dinu redirects the van after looking at red thread.
A_scene.purpose: Connect Dinu's personal obligations with Mudalali's control over his movements.

after_in_story.heading: SCENE 04 - EXT. OLD PORT WAREHOUSE - NIGHT - 2.5 MINUTES
after_in_story.ends_with: Dinu throws the cash bags into the van, reverses through the metal gate and escapes into Colombo traffic.
after_in_story.opens_with: The cash van enters an abandoned warehouse. All lights go off. Dinu turns off the engine and steps into the rain. Masked men surround him. Nimal appears from behind a container.

threads.subject: red thread
threads.summary: The wrist thread becomes a visual bridge from Dinu's troubled attachment to the final renewed bond.
this_scene: Dinu looks at red thread around his wrist before changing route.

later.note: Aruni ties red thread back around Dinu's wrist; it remains the final image.

looks.note: red thread is initially around his wrist and is tied back on by Aruni at the end; when or how it came off is unstated.

relationships.state: Nimal characterizes their relationship as endangered by Dinu's fear, not lack of money; this remains Nimal's claim.

summary.value:
Dinu

summary.value:
Aruni
27, Mahawewa community nurse. Strong, intelligent and emotionally
controlled.

B_people.wants: Get reassurance about Nimal and Dinu's arrival.

B_people.name: Mudalali

Mudalali
52, businessman laundering illegal money through village development
projects.

events.change: Dinu drives Cash Van through wet streets illuminated by sodium lighting.

E_blocks.text: On the dashboard is a faded photo of him and Aruni near a village bus stop.

events.change: A dashboard photograph establishes a shared memory of Dinu and Aruni at a rural bus stop.

E_blocks.text: Nimal thama gedara awilla ne. Oya ada enawa kiyala kiwwa. Mata dan baya hithenawa.
E_blocks.speaker: C02
E_blocks.intent: Report Nimal's absence and seek reassurance from Dinu.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Personal and increasingly anxious rather than accusatory.

events.change: Dinu hears that Nimal has not returned and that Aruni is frightened while awaiting his visit.
An incoming call brings Mudalali into the scene remotely.

E_blocks.text: Route eka maru karapan. Old Port warehouse ekata yanna.
E_blocks.speaker: C04
E_blocks.intent: Make Dinu abandon his current route and proceed to Old Port Warehouse.
E_blocks.delivery_hint: Clipped authority, with no invitation to negotiate.

events.change: Mudalali supplies a replacement destination at Old Port Warehouse.

E_blocks.text: Dinu looks at the red thread around his wrist and turns toward the industrial area.

events.change: Dinu checks the thread on his wrist, then steers toward the industrial district.

G_direction.text:
Colombo palette
Cold blue, green and sodium orange. Handheld camera, tight frames and
crowded backgrounds.

Lighting
Vehicle headlights, sodium lamps, practical bulbs and lightning flashes.

Editing
Fast cuts only on impact. Let important punches and reactions stay on screen.

Sound
Rain, breathing, metal impacts and footsteps first. Music enters only for hero
elevation moments.

Slow motion
Use only twice: Nimal's key falling and Dinu removing the gun.

ACTION DESIGN NOTES
The action is mass but not weightless. Every hit has a location, an object or a consequence. Dinu is not an invincible
superhero; he wins because he knows vehicles, space and timing. Aruni is an active participant in the climax, and the
final victory comes from the recording, the village and their courage - not from violence alone.
